pages.title: Conjure Island: Archwood Forest
pages.description: Creates an island of  grass and dirt in a  circle around the  ritual, converting  the area to an  Archwood Forest.  Augmenting with an  Elemental Archfruit  with convert to a  thematic forest. The  island will generate  with a radius of 7  blocks. Augmenting  the ritual with
Source Gems will  increase the radius  by 1 for each gem.  Source must be  provided nearby as  blocks are  generated.
